_doc: Starter sets for `python -m backend.cli setup init --preset=<name>` (backend/seed_manager.py, init_preset).
`templates` is a list of shipped question-set ids to install, or "all". Sets not listed are marked as
already handled, so they do not appear on the next start either; `templates restore --id=<id>` brings one in later.
`settings` are written to preferences.json (only keys not yet set by the person).
Nothing here ever deletes a file: running init on an existing install only adds what is missing.
